title: Dead Air
hook: She was dead by 00:40. So who was talking on air at 01:10?
briefing:
**Friday, 6 March 2026.** *After Midnight with Thandi* was the most-loved late show on **Atlantic 99.4 FM**. At 01:31, producer **Sipho Dlamini** found host **Thandi Mokoena (41)** dead on the floor of Studio B.

Listeners heard Thandi introduce a song at **01:10**. The pathologist puts time of death **between 00:30 and 00:50**.

Someone kept her voice on air after she died. Read everything. Trust nobody. When you are sure, name the killer, say how it was done and why, and pin the three pieces of evidence that prove it.

You have three accusations. After that, the case goes cold.

evidence.title: Police incident report
evidence.source: SAPS Cape Town Central · Det. Sgt. N. Jacobs

body.markdown:
**Incident:** Sudden death, Atlantic 99.4 FM, Harbour House, Cape Town CBD.
**Reported:** 01:36, 6 March 2026, by Sipho Dlamini (producer) via 10111.

First officers arrived 01:49. The security guard, Mr F. Abrahams, let them in at the main door. The deceased, **Thandi Mokoena (41)**, presenter, lay face down beside the mixing desk in Studio B with a head wound. A glass-and-steel award plaque lay on the floor near her.

First officers recorded a **possible fall** against the desk. Detectives and forensics entered at 02:20 using the police override badge.

Notes for the investigation:
- The station was on air the whole night. Music played automatically after 00:41.
- A grey Corolla, plate **CA 412-778**, was reported loitering outside earlier. See the guard's night log.
- Station manager Marguerite Vos was contacted at 02:05 and came in for interview at 03:40.

evidence.title: Pathologist's preliminary summary
evidence.source: Forensic Pathology Service · Dr A. Pillay

body.markdown:
**Cause of death:** blunt force trauma to the left temple.

The wound has a sharp right-angled edge. It is **not** consistent with the rounded edge of the mixing desk. It is consistent with a heavy object that has a hard corner.

**Estimated time of death: between 00:30 and 00:50** on 6 March (body temperature, lividity, rigor).

Stomach contents: rooibos tea, recently drunk.

I do not agree with "fall" as the manner of death.

evidence.title: Statement: Sipho Dlamini
evidence.source: Interview by Det. Sgt. N. Jacobs

lines.text: I've produced Thandi's show for six years. She was family.
At 00:28 I went out the side door for a smoke. I stood outside the whole time, maybe 25 minutes.
When I came back at 00:53 the auto-playlist was running and the Studio B blinds were down. She does that when she's prepping.
I heard her link at 01:10 through the booth speakers. I was reading the text line. It sounded normal.
At 01:28 the silence alarm went. I knocked, then went in. She was on the floor.
Yes, she said she wanted a new producer. We'd sorted it out.

timestamps.label: Sipho says he was smoking outside

evidence.title: Statement: Marguerite Vos
evidence.source: Interview by Det. Sgt. N. Jacobs

lines.text: I've run Atlantic for nine years. Thandi was our biggest star.
I left at about 23:30 and went home. I didn't come back.
I couldn't sleep, so I drove out for petrol at about ten past one. I have the receipt.
Thandi and I never had a problem. Not about work, not about anything.
Thandi never used voice tracks on her own show. She was always live. Everyone knows that.
Sipho and Thandi had been fighting about his job. Ask him.

timestamps.label: Marguerite says she was at home

evidence.title: Statement: Daniel Okafor
evidence.source: Interview by Det. Sgt. N. Jacobs

lines.text: Thandi and I were rivals on air and friends off air. Mostly.
Yes, I sent her an angry voice note. She told management I wasn't ready for prime time.
I didn't leave my flat after ten o'clock. I was alone.
I never went near the station. Check whatever you like.

timestamps.label: Daniel says he was at home

evidence.title: Statement: Lena Hartmann
evidence.source: Interview by Det. Sgt. N. Jacobs

lines.text: Thandi and I split up in January. It hurt, but we were adults about it.
I came to the station at about quarter past twelve to return her house keys. Security gave me a visitor badge.
We spoke for a few minutes in the corridor during a song. She was cold with me. I left before half past.
I went straight to La Mesa in Green Point to meet my friend Mia.
I work for Rooibos & Co, one of the station's sponsors. Weeks ago I told Thandi our invoices from Atlantic looked higher than the airtime we got.

evidence.title: Lab note: the award plaque
evidence.source: Forensic Science Lab · item 2

body.markdown:
**Item 2:** glass-and-steel award plaque, 'Station of the Year 2024', 2.1 kg.

Blood and hair matching the deceased on the top right corner. The corner matches the wound shape described by the pathologist.

The surface was wiped. Black wool fibres were caught on the base edge, consistent with gloves. No usable fingerprints.

body.markdown:
